name: search
description: Select-with-search: type to filter a full-width dropdown of options, or arrow through the full set from an empty query.
designIntent: A native <select> cannot filter and a free text input cannot constrain. Search covers the middle: constrained choice with inline filtering, full combobox a11y (role=combobox/aria-activedescendant), and a listbox that portals with fixed positioning so scrollable containers never clip it.

props.name: options
props.description: The full option set; filtered client-side as the user types.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected option value (display starts on its label).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the selected option's value.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Input placeholder while no query is typed.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown when no option matches the query.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the input and the dropdown.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected value; display follows it (null clears).

props.name: listLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the results listbox. Defaults to the input aria-label, then "Search results".

examples.title: Constrained pick from a list
examples.code:
<Search
  aria-label="Assign to"
  placeholder="Search people…"
  options={people}
  onValueChange={(value) => setAssignee(value)}
/>
examples.description: Keyboard: ArrowDown opens, arrows move, Enter selects, Escape closes.

examples.title: With descriptions and keywords
examples.description: keywords widen matching without widening the visible label.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Search for free-form input
antiPatterns.explanation: Search constrains the result to known options. For values the system has never seen (tags, new names) use Input or Autocomplete instead.

antiPatterns.title: Don't feed hundreds of options without keywords
antiPatterns.explanation: The list is filtered client-side; large sets need keywords/descriptions so short queries hit. For server-side search, debounce the query and swap the options prop — do not render raw HTML in labels.

antiPatterns.title: Don't rely on the placeholder as the field's name
antiPatterns.explanation: The placeholder disappears once typing starts. Pass aria-label (standalone) or wrap the Search in FormField for a persistent accessible name.

accessibility.implementation: Input exposes role=combobox with aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-autocomplete=list, and aria-activedescendant pointing at the active option
accessibility.userRequirements: Provide a name: aria-label or a wrapping FormField label

accessibility.implementation: ArrowDown/ArrowUp move the active option (wrapping), Home/End jump, Enter selects, Escape closes without clearing
Option mousedown is prevented so focus stays in the input while clicking; typing continues immediately after selection
The listbox portals to document.body with fixed coordinates measured from the input and closes on scroll/resize

guidelines: Keep labels unique or disambiguate with description

compositionRules.relationship: Wrap in FormField when the search sits in a form — the label is cloned onto the input
Choose Search for constrained picks; Autocomplete when free-form values must stay allowed
